correctness.rationale: The metric characterization is necessary and sufficient: a selected matched core–pendant pair forces the core onto a shortest path to any third selected vertex, while in the absence of matched pairs the only internal vertices on geodesics between selected vertices are unselected core mates of pendant endpoints. Counting then gives (1+2x)^n+n x^2. Strict log-concavity is verified symbolically at the only three affected indices and inherited from the scaled binomial tail elsewhere. A separate distance-based exhaustive checker confirms all coefficients through n=10.

value.rationale: The 2024 paper explicitly asks for corona preservation of unimodality, and the 2026 follow-up continues that program while showing log-concavity can fail. The complete-graph family is canonical, connected, and not among the previously stated positive corona classes. The result gives an exact polynomial and the stronger strict log-concavity property, so it contributes nontrivial structural information beyond the known maximum size.
